fields.System.Title: FDN-701 — Reason codes
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a system administrator, I want a controlled list of reason codes, so that every
exception has a name that can be counted and analysed.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given the reason code list, then each code has a category — adjustment, short receipt,
  • short pick, putaway override, scrap, count correction.
  • - Given a stock change endpoint, then it accepts only a code from the list for its
  • category, never free text alone.
  • - Given a code in use, then it can be deactivated but not deleted.
  • - Given a deactivated code, then historical records still resolve it.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | masterdata |
| Tables | reason_code |
| Risks | Vague codes have no analytical value ([doc 05 WF 13](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
